$comment: What doberman knows about this template: how to recognize it, its gates, its risk areas. scripts/doberman.mjs reads it; keep it in step with package.json, .github/workflows/quality-gates.yml and docs/testing.md.
displayName: Golden Template Web (NestJS API, React SPA and Astro landing)

typecheck.name: Typecheck (web contract types check and astro check included)

test:coverage.name: Unit + component tests + coverage thresholds (OpenAPI drift spec included)

security.name: Security (audit, dependency policy, secrets in the tree)

extraGates.name: Infrastructure as code (Terraform fmt, validate and tests, TFLint, Trivy, cloud-init schema, database roles script)
extraGates.note: Downloads the Terraform providers and cloud-init from the Ubuntu archive at each run. Creates nothing in any cloud and needs no token: a real plan or apply is never part of a review.

extraGates.name: Repository script tests (Doberman engine, Semgrep file selection)
Observability as code (dashboards, alert rules, promtool)
extraGates.note: Static checks of observability/ (datasource references, runbook sections, metric names against observability/api-metrics.json), then promtool from the pinned image: configuration, rules, every dashboard query parsed, the rules' unit tests. The static part also runs in pnpm test:scripts.

extraGates.name: Secrets in the git history (gitleaks)
extraGates.commandWindows: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 docker run --rm -v "$(cygpath -w "$PWD"):/repo:ro" "$(node scripts/tool-image.mjs gitleaks)" git /repo --redact --no-banner

extraGates.name: Integration tests (API + PostgreSQL)
extraGates.note: Runs on <db>_test, never the development database. The Redis adapter specs run only with REDIS_TEST_URL (required in CI, skipped locally without it: say so).

extraGates.name: End-to-end tests (Playwright, built stack)
extraGates.note: Playwright starts the API (e2e:server, on <db>_e2e), the web preview and the landing preview itself. Installing the browser is the developer's decision: without it, SKIPPED — REQUIRES CONFIGURATION (`pnpm exec playwright install chromium`).

extraGates.name: Container images (build + Trivy scan)
extraGates.command: per .github/workflows/docker-images.yml: docker build of apps/api/Dockerfile (targets runtime and migrate) and apps/web/Dockerfile (target runtime: the landing and the app), tagged doberman-scan/<image>, then the Trivy scan of each with `node scripts/tool-image.mjs trivy` and the workflow's flags; remove the doberman-scan images afterwards

database.note: The template's PostgreSQL (docker-compose.yml, service db). The suites use <db>_test and <db>_e2e on it.

areas.focus: refresh rotation with family revocation and race leeway, user row lock, cookie attributes, sign-in timing, password hashing, token claims
@Auth(...) on every non-public route, roles, ownership checks in the service (another user's id → 404), no IDOR
Zod DTOs with bounds, explicit select, pagination limits, error paths, transactions and locks, idempotency
committed migration, never an edited one, expand/contract safety while the previous version runs, indexes for new queries, no unbounded queries, no $queryRawUnsafe
regenerated by pnpm contract, backwards compatibility, status codes, envelope, pagination, auth requirements declared
access token in memory only, single-flight refresh + Web Lock across tabs, epoch guard, sign-in waits for logout/refresh in flight, other tabs told, guards
only the api client and call(), useLoader's latest-request-wins, no fetch elsewhere, error folding
loading/empty/error/retry states, double submit, navigation during requests, role guards in the router, accessible names, no XSS sinks

every text in both dictionaries (src/i18n), a page per language; static HTML and CSS only (no client script, no inline style, nothing from another origin: the CSP refuses them; 0 kB JavaScript budget); one h1, headings, landmarks, lang attributes, labelled pictures of the app; links into the app through src/lib/links.ts; canonical, hreflang, sitemap and robots.txt from the build site
process.env read only in env.ts, schema + .env.example + docs together, optional integrations off by default and never stopping the boot
CacheService/LockService/IdempotencyService only, degradation when Redis is absent, readiness probe, external calls through createExternalHttpClient (timeouts, SSRF)
Fetch Metadata CSRF guard, CORS origins, rate limits (auth routes), security headers and CSP, cache headers

redaction, ids not personal data, errorTracker/reportError once, low-cardinality metric attributes, dashboards and alert rules reading only exported metrics, every alert with severity, runbook and a unit test

non-root images, pinned digests, migrations before the new version, no secrets in images or compose files, docs/deploy-vps.md and both step-by-step guides updated; Terraform (infra/terraform) reproduces docs/deploy-vps.md: no secret with a default or in a non-sensitive output, firewalls as narrow as the guide, the lock file and the pinned versions updated together
justified, added to the app that uses it, supply-chain settings never weakened, no new install scripts
no gate, threshold, rule or permission weakened; workflows least privilege, pinned, no pull request path to deployments
would the tests fail if the code were wrong: authorization matrix, failure paths, races, realistic stubs
manual and step-by-step guides changed in English and Spanish together; deployment changes reflected in docs/deploy-vps.md

reproduction.fileSuffix: .doberman.spec.ts(x) for unit and component tests, .doberman.int.spec.ts for API integration
reproduction.location: next to the code under test: apps/web/src/**, apps/landing/src/** (not src/pages, where a file becomes a page) or apps/api/src/** (each runner only collects its app's src/)
reproduction.runOne: web: pnpm --filter web exec vitest run --coverage=false <path from apps/web> · landing: pnpm --filter landing exec vitest run --coverage=false <path from apps/landing> · API unit: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run <path from apps/api> · API integration (database): pnpm --filter api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.int.ts <path from apps/api>
